title: Engine core
body: The engine crate now runs real matches: a fixed 60 Hz, seeded 2D sim with a walled arena, rectangular obstacles, tanks with heading, turret, velocity and HP, projectiles with cooldowns, and last-team-standing or tick-limit endings. Every match records a JSON replay that re-simulates to the identical state. engine-cli runs N matches between two placeholder bots and prints JSON.
next: Tank rules once the spec clears Nye's gate, then a wasm viewer that plays replays live.
